category.reason: Use the order of the months to infer that September is between August and October; this is a low-difficulty sequence-reasoning anchor.

instruction.en: Navigate to the month that falls between August and October in the yearly calendar view
instruction.zh: 在全年日历视图中，导航到位于八月和十月之间的月份。
